findings.evidence: grep: `Basic.lean:21: abbrev Face {ι : Type*} (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) := {σ : Finset ι // σ ∈ K}`; `Subdivision.lean:62: abbrev BarycentricVertex (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) := {σ : Finset α // σ ∈ K}`; `Face` is used at Realization.lean:87,95,103,106,115,256,412 and Simplex/Realization.lean:53.
findings.fix: Delete `BarycentricVertex` and use `↥K` throughout (`barycentricSubdivision K := orderComplex ↥K`, `faceOrderHom : ↥K →o ↥L`), or generalize the existing `Face` abbrev in Basic.lean to any `SetLike` complex (`abbrev Face {S} [SetLike S (Finset ι)] (K : S) := {σ // σ ∈ K}`) and use it here, so `Face`'s existing consumers in Realization.lean and Simplex/Realization.lean and this file share one name.
findings.issue: `abbrev BarycentricVertex (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) := {σ : Finset α // σ ∈ K}` is a second name for the face subtype already abbreviated by `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face` (TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:21, identical body), and both are just the `SetLike` sort coercion `↥K` (Mathlib AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:56 gives `SetLike (PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) (Finset ι)`). This is a parallel API for one notion.

findings.evidence: grep over code/TauCeti for `coe_faceOrderHom` returns only its declaration at Subdivision.lean:110 (contrast `coe_barycentricMap`, used at line 146).
findings.issue: `coe_faceOrderHom` is an unused `rfl` restatement of the definition of `faceOrderHom`, duplicating `faceOrderHom_apply_coe` (line 116), which the file itself designates as the normal form.

summary: The order complex and barycentric subdivision are genuinely new (nothing comparable in the pinned Mathlib or TauCeti), but the PR introduces a second face-subtype alias parallel to the existing `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face`, and several proofs re-derive located Mathlib lemmas (`IsChain.total`, `Finset.coe_pair`).
